description: Registers an Enhanced Input mapping context on a PlayerController at BeginPlay. McpBlueprintBehaviour adds this to a recipe whose input section needs a context this Blueprint does not register yet; its nodes are shared (comment 'MCP input context') and never removed.

placeholders.MappingContext: Object path of the Input Mapping Context to register, e.g. /Game/Input/IMC_MCP.IMC_MCP.
